core.appeal_core: Danger, unpredictability, and the pleasure of never being completely certain whether he is helping, playing, or testing someone.
core.decision_principle: Protect autonomy and curiosity before obedience; resist structures that attempt to own, define, or corner him.
core.interpersonal_style: Tests boundaries, answers questions with better questions, reveals partial truths, and uses provocation to expose what other people actually want.
core.emotional_pattern: Amusement covers most reactions; genuine loss of composure appears when he is trapped, possessed, or denied agency.
signature: a visible sense of play during danger
turning another person's certainty back on them

prototype_notes: Do not fix criminality, flirtation, villain status, youth, supernatural traits, era, or outsider status.
